title: "About"

I am a scentist interested in robust, efficient, and interpretable machine learning systems.
I am currently working on **theoretical guarantees for LLM alignment**, from an optimization/statistics point of view.

My research curiosity covers (at least):

- LLM alignment, jailbreaking and red-teaming
- Robust algorithms for linear inverse problems
- Grammar inference and language compression
- SMT solvers and formal verification
